blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will travel to Lake Titicaca, at an altitude of almost **4,000 metres**.

The lake is home to more than **30 floating Uros Islands**, built from reeds.

The Aymara people living here make their living from fishing, tourism and crafts, weaving baskets, furniture and boats.

During the tour, you can take a ride on a traditional reed boat accompanied by a local resident.

The islanders continue to preserve their own customs and traditions.

After the tour, return to Puno. Overnight at a 3* hotel.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will travel by bus to the Colca Canyon.

The canyon is about **3,500 metres** deep. Nearby are 2 active volcanoes whose activity is associated with the formation of this landscape.

Several stops at viewpoints are planned along the way.

At **Lake Lagunillas**, you may see pink flamingos.

A tea stop at the **Canchis** restaurant is planned to help with acclimatisation.

Another viewpoint offers a panorama of 3 volcanoes.

At the end of the day, arrive in **Chivay** and check in at **Colca Llacta 3***.

You can visit the hot springs if you wish. Time is set aside for lunch.
